about: SHARD-COMPAT CP14: format 0.1.0.2 names itself in formatVersion (no version, no layout marker) and drops the four always-empty index fields (FORMAT-PRUNE FP4, FP25). No real upload is written at 0.1.0.2 until the SDK moves (Track F), so the fixture is Brasscap's export migrated by the chain; replace it with the first real 0.1.0.2 engine pin.
